title.purpose: Chapter titles beside each lotus lamp.

dek.purpose: Goudy italic line under a section title, in text-soft, 36 to 38ch.

note.purpose: Goudy italic hero note (fluid clamp(1.0625rem, 0.95rem + 0.3vw, 1.5rem), 48ch) and book caption (1.0625rem), in text-soft.

label.purpose: Uppercase Trajan button text; 0.875rem on the large button, 0.16em tracking on phones.

shadows.name: lamplight-underglow
shadows.purpose: Primary button at rest: warm blush light on water beneath it.

shadows.name: lamplight-underglow-hover
shadows.purpose: Primary button hover, paired with a 2px lift.

shadows.name: book-rest
shadows.purpose: The Legend cover as a physical object.

shadows.name: book-spine
shadows.value: linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4), rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08) 4%, transparent 9%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05) 11%, transparent 14%)
shadows.purpose: Spine shading overlay so the cover reads as a book.

shadows.name: hero-glow
shadows.purpose: Low blush light behind the hero actions.

shadows.name: curtain-glow
shadows.purpose: Velvet light at the top of the oxblood Collection band.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single easing for lifts, glows, lamps and entrances.

motion.name: unveil
motion.purpose: Hero key visual: the lamps come up on the palace.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Hero actions, note and scroll cue settle after the unveil.

motion.name: kindle
motion.value: petal fill 1.1s, pool 1.6s, flame 1.2s after 0.3s, title colour 1s
motion.purpose: A lamp lights when its chapter enters view (IntersectionObserver, rootMargin 0 0 -30% 0).

motion.name: flicker
motion.value: 3.2s ease-in-out 1.4s infinite; scale(0.9, 1.08) at 40%, scale(1.04, 0.95) at 70%

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: transition and animation 0.01ms, 1 iteration, scroll-behavior auto
motion.purpose: Entrance animations only under no-preference; under reduce everything settles instantly and lamps show lit.

breakpoints.name: portrait
breakpoints.purpose: Hero crops to a 1.3:1 window on the lettering.

breakpoints.name: short-landscape
breakpoints.purpose: Hero drops the scroll cue so the first screen fits.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Cream-gold printed button with an inset rule and warm underglow. One per view.
components.html: Explore the range
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1.05em; min-height: 4.15em; padding: 1.17em 2.34em 1.05em; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 2px; font-family: var(--font-display, Cinzel, serif); font-size: clamp(0.8125rem, 0.7rem + 0.25vw, 1.125rem); letter-spacing: 0.2em; line-height: 1.2; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.3s, border-color 0.3s, color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-arrow { width: 1.5rem; height: 0.75rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.1; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:hover .ds-arrow { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold-300, #e3c47a); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--gold-100, #f6e3aa); color: var(--ink, #2a1012); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.4), 0 16px 28px -18px rgb(252 182 160 / 0.45); } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 4px; border: 1px solid rgb(42 16 18 / 0.22); border-radius: 1px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--gold-50, #fef3ca); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5), 0 20px 34px -18px rgb(252 182 160 / 0.6); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Night ground, strong gold hairline, cream-gold label. The secondary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 4.15em; padding: 1.17em 2.34em 1.05em; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, rgb(211 175 55 / 0.55)); border-radius: 2px; background: rgb(18 17 24 / 0.8); color: var(--gold-50, #fef3ca); font-family: var(--font-display, Cinzel, serif); font-size: clamp(0.8125rem, 0.7rem + 0.25vw, 1.125rem); letter-spacing: 0.2em; line-height: 1.2; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.3s, border-color 0.3s, transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: rgb(211 175 55 / 0.12); border-color: var(--gold-300, #e3c47a); } .ds-btn-quiet:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold-300, #e3c47a); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Large Primary Button
components.description: The single closing action on the oxblood band.
components.html: View the collection
components.css: .ds-btn-large { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.85rem; min-height: 3.875rem; padding: 0.95rem 2.6rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--gold-100, #f6e3aa); color: var(--ink, #2a1012); font-family: var(--font-display, Cinzel, serif); font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.4), 0 16px 28px -18px rgb(252 182 160 / 0.45); transition: background-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-large::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 4px; border: 1px solid rgb(42 16 18 / 0.22); border-radius: 1px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-arrow-l { width: 1.5rem; height: 0.75rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.1; stroke-linecap: round; transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-large:hover { background: var(--gold-50, #fef3ca); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5), 0 20px 34px -18px rgb(252 182 160 / 0.6); } .ds-btn-large:hover .ds-arrow-l { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-btn-large:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold-300, #e3c47a); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Textlink
components.description: Goudy italic link with a gold underline and arrow; the lesser alternative beside a quiet button.
components.html: or explore the range
components.css: .ds-textlink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Sorts Mill Goudy', serif); font-size: 1.1875rem; font-style: italic; color: var(--gold-100, #f6e3aa); text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.28em; text-decoration-color: rgb(211 175 55 / 0.45); transition: color 0.3s, text-decoration-color 0.3s; } .ds-arrow-t { width: 1.5rem; height: 0.75rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.1; stroke-linecap: round; transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-textlink:hover { color: var(--gold-50, #fef3ca); text-decoration-color: var(--gold-300, #e3c47a); } .ds-textlink:hover .ds-arrow-t { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-textlink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold-300, #e3c47a); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Lotus-Lamp Marker
components.description: Chapter marker on the Legend path. Unlit: gold outline, no flame. Hover the demo to kindle it.
components.html: The Lake Awakes
components.css: .ds-lamp-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1rem; background: #121118; } .ds-lamp { width: 3.5rem; height: 3.5rem; overflow: visible; } .ds-lamp-pool { fill: url(#ds-lamp-glow); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-lamp-flame { fill: #fef3ca; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 50% 100%; opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.3); transition: opacity 0.8s 0.3s, transform 1.2s 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-lamp-petal { fill: rgb(211 175 55 / 0); stroke: rgb(211 175 55 / 0.55); stroke-width: 0.8; transition: fill 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), stroke 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-lamp-water { fill: none; stroke: #d3af37; stroke-width: 1; stroke-linecap: round; opacity: 0.55; } .ds-lamp-title { font-family: var(--font-display, Cinzel, serif); font-size: 1.375rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #e3c47a; transition: color 1s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-lamp-row:hover .ds-lamp-pool { opacity: 1; } .ds-lamp-row:hover .ds-lamp-flame { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } .ds-lamp-row:hover .ds-lamp-petal { fill: #f97983; stroke: #e3c47a; } .ds-lamp-row:hover .ds-lamp-side { fill: #e0646b; } .ds-lamp-row:hover .ds-lamp-title { color: #fef3ca; }

components.name: Book Cover
components.description: The Legend cover tilted -2.5deg with spine shading and a deep fall; straightens and lifts on hover.
components.html: The Legend of the Moonlight Lilies
components.css: .ds-book { position: relative; display: block; width: 12rem; aspect-ratio: 720 / 1019; transform: rotate(-2.5deg); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgb(211 175 55 / 0.25), 0 36px 60px -24px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.85), 0 12px 24px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6); transition: transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); text-decoration: none; } .ds-book-face { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; height: 100%; padding: 1.5rem 1rem; background: linear-gradient(#2a2833, #45191a); color: #fef3ca; font-family: var(--font-display, Cinzel, serif); text-align: center; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-book::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4), rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08) 4%, transparent 9%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05) 11%, transparent 14%); pointer-events: none; } .ds-book:hover { transform: rotate(-0.5deg) translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgb(211 175 55 / 0.35), 0 48px 70px -26px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.9), 0 16px 30px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6); } .ds-book:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e3c47a; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Feathered Key-Visual Hero
components.description: Full-screen stage (100svh). The 3:1 key visual is the h1, sized min(112%, 2400px, (screen height - reserve) x 3) so the actions always fit on the first screen, feathered into the night; actions overlap its lower fade; a 'The Legend' scroll cue sits in the bottom padding. Portrait screens crop to 1.3:1 on the lettering.
components.html: Explore the range
components.css: .ds-hero { background: radial-gradient(55% 45% at 50% 62%, rgb(252 182 160 / 0.1), transparent 72%), #1b1a23; padding-bottom: 2rem; text-align: center; overflow: hidden; } .ds-hero-art { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 3 / 1; background: radial-gradient(40% 60% at 50% 40%, #e3c47a, transparent), linear-gradient(#2a2833, #632825); -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 7%, #000 93%, transparent), linear-gradient(transparent, #000 6%, #000 66%, transparent 99%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 7%, #000 93%, transparent), linear-gradient(transparent, #000 6%, #000 66%, transparent 99%); mask-composite: intersect; animation: ds-unveil 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } .ds-hero-actions { position: relative; margin-top: -1.5rem; animation: ds-rise 1.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.8s both; } .ds-hero-btn { display: inline-block; padding: 0.95rem 1.9rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 2px; background: #f6e3aa; color: #2a1012; font-family: var(--font-display, Cinzel, serif); font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; } @keyframes ds-unveil { from { filter: brightness(0.4) saturate(0.7); transform: scale(1.03); } } @keyframes ds-rise { from { opacity: 0.3; transform: translateY(10px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-hero-art, .ds-hero-actions { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The page is the palace night of the supplied key visual, extended downward: a dark slate sky that deepens toward the lake, then gives way to the oxblood of the theatre curtains. Lettering is cream-gold Trajan capitals, the same voice as the title on the banner; the narrative speaks in Goudy, and the italic is its storytelling voice. Colour beyond night, oxblood and gold arrives only as light: the coral and blush of lotus lamps, their pools on the water, the warm underglow beneath a button.

The world is brief-pinned to the client's key visual ("use the same fonts same colors"), so the banner is the source of truth for hue, type and atmosphere. Density is low and ceremonial: wide section padding, a single centred column at the open and close, a two-column book-and-path spread in the middle. Ornament is restricted to the world's own materials: gold hairlines, the lotus lamp, the gold lily line art.
keyCharacteristics: Night-slate and oxblood grounds; no light sections.
Cream-gold Trajan capitals for every heading and label; Goudy for reading, italic for the narrator.
Lotus coral and blush appear only as light, never as fills of any size.
Gold hairlines (26% and 55% gold) draw every rule, border and path.
Motion is lamplight: things brighten, kindle and flicker; nothing slides in from the side.

rules.name: The Lamplight Rule
rules.body: Lotus coral, deep lotus and blush are light sources. They fill a petal, a glow, a pool or a shadow; they never fill a section, a card or a button.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are night (900 or 950) or oxblood (900 with a 600 glow). A third ground needs a reason in the key visual.

rules.name: The Licensed First Rule
rules.body: Every stack names the brand's licensed face first and its free stand-in second. Never ship a stack that skips to a system serif for display.

rules.name: The Italic Narrator Rule
rules.body: Goudy italic is the voice that speaks to the visitor (deks, notes, captions, the textlink). Roman Goudy is the story itself.

rules.name: The No Bold Rule
rules.body: Headings stay at weight 400 with tracking for emphasis; font-synthesis-weight is off.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow under a lettered control is warm blush light, offset low and blurred; black shadows belong only to physical objects such as the book.

dos: Do take every hue from the key visual; it is the authority for colour and type in this world.
Do set headings and labels in the Trajan stack at weight 400 with tracking (0.05em to 0.2em), and reading text in the Goudy stack.
Do use Goudy italic in text-soft for deks, notes and captions.
Do draw rules, borders and paths as 1px gold hairlines (rule or rule-strong).
Do keep lotus and blush as light: petals, pools, glows, underglow.
Do keep one primary (cream-gold) action per view, paired with at most a quiet button or a textlink.
Do gate entrance motion behind prefers-reduced-motion and make every lamp lit without JS.
donts: Don't add a header, footer or top bar (user direction, 22 October 2026).
Don't list products or prices on the page; the page ends at The Collection with one View the collection button (user direction).
Don't fill a section, card or button with lotus coral or blush.
Don't introduce a light ground or a product grid under the hero.
Don't bold Trajan or set the display stack without its licensed faces first.
Don't frame or round the key visual; it dissolves into the night through masks.
Don't add ornament outside the world's own set: gold hairlines, the lotus lamp and the gold lily line art.
